instagram.caption:
The twelve settings from your grandmother.
The China or Display Cabinet in the Dining Room. Keep the good tableware safe, visible, and genuinely usable.

What done looks like:
1. Plates stacked no more than eight high with felt between them
2. Cups standing single file rather than nested
3. Glasses rim up on a clean liner
4. Tureens on the bottom shelf
